role: Git-based screened dataset workflows — the network's direct source of qualified, cleansed datasets. PR-reviewed before ingestion; researcher/org-facing.

provides.surface: contributions/{contributor}/{dataset}/metadata.json + CSV/GeoJSON, validated against schemas/metadata.schema.json (GitHub Actions, scripts/validate-pr.mjs)
provides.note: Single validation authority for both the git-PR path and the on-prem field/gateway path (see docs/ingestion-paths.md). Qualified/cleansed; field/agent-authored readings stay quality_level: preliminary until reviewed.
